name: One edge value booked in two node ledgers with a declared integer delay, and the inbound (stacked) debt it induces, with TAU_UNDECLARED refusal -- NEW DERIVATION / PROPOSAL -- not yet in Toledo

statement.latest: \text{Declared finite graph } G=(N,E), \text{ tick } \tau, \text{ all values on } \mathbb{Q}. \text{ For a declared edge } e=(u,v) \text{ with a DECLARED delay } d_e\in\mathbb{N} \text{ (ticks): } \boxed{Q_e(k)\cdot\tau \text{ is one value, a summand of } Q_{out,u}(k)\tau \text{ and of } Q_{in,v}(k+d_e)\tau} \text{ (nothing arrives at } v \text{ before } d_e\text{). Consequence (proved): } \sum_{j<t+d_e} in_v(j) = \sum_{k<t} out_u(k) \text{ -- booking with delay conserves volume across the two ledgers. Inbound (stacked) debt at } b: \boxed{D_{in}(b;k_{now},H) := \sum_{e=(s\to b)}\ \sum_{k\le k_{now},\ k_{now}<k+d_e\le k_{now}+H} Q_e(k)\,\tau} \text{ -- depends only on values released at or before } k_{now}; \text{ zero for } d_e=0; \text{ saturates at } H=d_e. \quad \boxed{\text{REFUSED TAU\_UNDECLARED}} \text{ when any inbound edge's } d_e \text{ is undeclared (never read as 0); the refusal applies to the inbound term only.}
statement.note_ascii: NEW DERIVATION / PROPOSAL -- not yet in Toledo. Delta 1 ONLY. For a declared edge e = (u, v) with a declared integer delay d_e (ticks; declared or measured, never derived -- EQ-001/P.61.v1), the SAME per-tick value Q_e(k)*tau is a summand of Q_out,u(k) and of Q_in,v(k + d_e); nothing is booked into v before tick d_e. Proved: total booked into v over ticks 0..t+d_e-1 equals total booked out of u over 0..t-1 (no creation, loss, or double count by the delay). Inbound stacked debt D_in(b; k_now, H) = sum over inbound edges of Q_e(k)*tau with k <= k_now < k + d_e <= k_now + H: water ALREADY released/measured upstream that will arrive within H. Proved: causal (depends only on k <= k_now), non-negative for non-negative flows, zero for d_e = 0, saturates at H = d_e (everything in transit), monotone in H. REFUSED TAU_UNDECLARED iff some inbound edge has no declared delay; the undeclared delay is never silently 0; the refusal touches only the inbound term (the node's rain term is unaffected). D_in enters PROP-FLOOD-03 as Q_in of the receiving node and PROP-FLOOD-06 as Q_in,up / tau_up, reported beside the rain term, never merged. Everything else a network-coupling rule needs is COMPOSITION (see composition table); no flow magnitude is supplied (w_e, cap_e undeclared). v1.1: a declared edge with no flow readout is modelled (flow as an option): the whole inbound term is REFUSED TAU_UNDECLARED if any inbound delay is undeclared (checked first), else REFUSED INPUT_ABSENT if any inbound flow is missing -- never 0 (d_in_node_full). Flows are per-tick volumes in the DECLARED orientation s -> b; d_in_nonneg needs q >= 0, so a reverse flow must be declared as its own edge.

definitions.d_e: declared or measured integer delay in ticks (option: None = undeclared -> TAU_UNDECLARED); tau_e = d_e * tau is the per-edge renaming of PROP-FLOOD-06 tau_up
definitions.Q_e(k): one Q-valued edge flow per tick (m^3/s; positive u -> v), declared or measured; q(k) := Q_e(k)*tau is the per-tick volume booked
definitions.booked_in(j): q(j - d_e) if j >= d_e else 0, a summand of Q_in,v(j)*tau
definitions.D_in(b; k_now, H): as in the statement; H in ticks

refusal_codes: INPUT_ABSENT (added to the Coq refusal type in v1.1 for an edge with no flow readout; same meaning as the PROP-FLOOD-03 MISSING_INPUT family downstream)
claim_boundary: A bookkeeping identity over declared readouts: no momentum, no Saint-Venant, no attenuation, no rating curve, no continuum limit. It does not supply a flow magnitude (w_e, cap_e are undeclared everywhere downstream; a linear or saturating edge-flow law would be a separate delta, not opened). It does not decompose a river stage into upstream inflow versus tide.
non_claims: Not a routing model: a pure integer delay with no attenuation or storage on the edge; if an edge stores water it must be declared as a node.
D_in is water already released or measured upstream -- a booked quantity, not a forecast of future releases.

No link is asserted for undeclared edges: e.g. Mae Klong releases are NOT booked into Bangkok units (downstream: drains to the Gulf at Samut Songkhram, INSTINCT) until a declared transfer with measured discharge exists.
Zero delay is a declaration (arrives within the tick), never the default for an unknown delay.
